name: Grounded Action Map
role: organizes needs, evidence, trust, learning, action, peacebuilding, and future capacity
description: The central public platform for moving from concern to responsible action.

name: Workshops and campus engagements
role: bring the platform into universities, civic communities, and leadership spaces
description: Structured sessions using sectors, action cards, simulations, and future capacity prompts.

name: Podcast
role: deep conversations with experts, practitioners, students, leaders, and people across communities
description: A responsible public education surface for long-form learning.

name: Video explainers
role: short explanations of humanitarian principles, peacebuilding lenses, trust evidence, and responsible action
description: Short-form public education prompts with caveats and review labels.

name: Learning pathways
role: turn needs into competencies, simulations, team learning, and action artifacts
description: Role-based pathways for users, teams, workshops, labs, and partner projects.

name: Simulation Lab
description: Scenario-based practice for WASH, education, trust, technology, peacebuilding, and uncertainty.

name: Partner network
role: connect universities, technologists, humanitarian advisors, peacebuilders, local organizations, and funders
description: A future review and pilot network for safe public beta.

name: Advisory review
role: protect credibility through humanitarian, trust/compliance, safeguarding, Gaza/oPt, peacebuilding, learning design, and technology review
description: Eight review tracks before public beta.

name: Public action ecosystem
role: help users find responsible pathways: donate, advocate, learn, build, partner, organize, and support capacity
description: A no-payment, no-ranking action intelligence layer.

name: Future Capacity Map
role: connect urgent action to long-term recovery, wellbeing, social cohesion, and peace capacity
description: From urgent response to generational recovery.

name: Diffusion and public education
role: help ideas spread responsibly through briefings, workshops, videos, share cards, and stakeholder demos
description: Responsible diffusion assets with caveats and non-manipulative language.
